envelope.description: Graph and symbol lookups return every result

body.title: Graph and symbol lookups return every result
body.summary: Delete the result-count constants and the limit and topK parameters from symbol-locate, test-locate, import-graph, usage-example, concept-resolve, manifests-locate, data-model-trace (MAX_TARGETS, MAX_FIELDS, MAX_TOP_CALLERS) and convention-detect (MAX_REPR_SUBCLASSES, MAX_BASE_CLASS_IDIOMS), so each returns everything it found with a completeness record that has no limited entry.
acceptanceChecks: Each of these lookups returns every result at, one over and zero versus its former limit
No limited entry appears in their completeness records

tests.name: completeness-all-lookups.test.ts: symbol-locate, test-locate, import-graph, usage-example, concept-resolve, manifests-locate, data-model-trace and convention-detect return every result at, one over and zero versus the former limit with no limited entry
